children: Preliminary outcome: Soltech’s fully guaranteed rights issue is ~97% subscribed, raising ~SEK 99M before costs. ~80% subscribed with rights, ~17% without; ~3% guarantee utilized.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Rights issue ~97% subscribed
High take-up reduces reliance on guarantees and signals shareholder support.
Gross proceeds ~SEK 99M
Bolsters liquidity; part offsets bridge loan via set-off.
Guarantee use ~3% of issue
Limited backstop usage suggests demand was near full cover.
SEK 20M set-off of bridge loan
De-levers short-term debt instead of adding equivalent cash.
New shares 1.98B (Comp: 126M)
Large issuance is dilutive; share count to ~3.43B post issues.
Costs ~SEK 2M (excl. guarantee fee)
Net proceeds slightly lower; additional dilution from fee shares.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a financing step continuing Soltech’s balance-sheet support amid ongoing operations on First North. A stronger catalyst would be clarity on use of proceeds, improved cash flow, or guidance showing accretive returns from the capital.
